study: PHGNN + prototype-guided missing PET, restart round 1

adapter.name: PHGNN plus independent missing-PET generator controlled ablations
adapter.neighbor_space: MRI PCA20 fitted on task-training patients only, concatenated with prepared tabular inputs
adapter.generator_fit_and_donor_pool: task training plus development background; excludes validation, test, held sites and locked patients
adapter.generator_selection: common SmoothL1 + 0.5*cosine-error on observed validation PET for every arm; no test-label selection
adapter.attention: unnormalized projected dot product divided by sqrt(attention_dim)
adapter.graph: original PHGNN incidence from original zero-filled encoded features fixed across arms
adapter.replacement: natural-missing PET embeddings only; observed PET and availability flags unchanged
adapter.hypergraph_peer: MRI/demo fixed kNN incidence; masked H.T-to-H pooling; empty-provider edges excluded

standardization_fit: current labeled task training fold only
encoder_pca_fallback_fit: observed training fold only; never all observed patients
mae_eligible: training fold plus unlabeled background; validation/test excluded
generator_fit_and_donors: training fold plus unlabeled background; validation/test excluded
graph_protocol: transductive: unlabeled validation/test features participate in propagation
baseline_graph: naive modality-kNN union, including zero PET rows
graph_ablation: baseline_observed: only observed PET nodes create/join PET hyperedges
module_downstream_graph: same original naive graph, fixed before imputation
hypergraph_provider_context: MRI/tab graph only, no PET-valued edge construction
selection: generator epoch by common validation PET reconstruction loss; downstream config/epoch/threshold by validation labels
interpretation: exploratory comparison; this cohort including locked sites was examined in earlier work; no new independent external-validation claim
future_confirmation: freeze method before ADNI/site-level evaluation; no publication readiness assumed

changes: Replaced the absolute local cohort path with a placeholder.
publication_copy.privacy: No cohort, patient rows, patient labels, predictions, graph or checkpoint data included.
publication_copy.replay: This derived document is for reading; it does not replace the frozen local protocol for resume or checkpoint checks.
